stem_book: A ball of mass 1 kg strikes elastically a heavy platform that is moving upwards with a velocity of 5 m/s. The speed of the ball just before the collision is 10 m/s downwards. Find the impulse (in N·s) imparted by the platform on the ball.
reason: Key 15 N·s treats 5 m/s as the ball's rebound speed; the 5 m/s belongs to the (heavy) platform, so elastic rebound gives ball 20 m/s up and J = 30 N·s (printed key also 15).
work: relative approach 15 m/s ⇒ ball leaves at 5+15 = 20 m/s up; J = 1·(20 − (−10)) = 30 N·s
